sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
minor maintenance P1, which must be performed on an annually bases indicated by 
Y1 in the title block

The technical 
of the circuit breaker : Rated current = 1500A, and short-circuit current = is 
21.2 kA, Rated voltage is 132 kv

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Abd Allah Elaiwah Sayed at High Dam 
Power Station on 20 Jan 2004, accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad: general director, 
approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zaid: High Dam head Sector, and certified by 
eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakeem: EPGC quality control general director, MPIS 
Coordinator.
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding work area is required
Wear safety equipment's as helmet, shoes
Switch off the C.B and discharge the compressed air
Switch off is connectors at circuit breaker side
Switch off D.C supply control of C.B
Connect the ground at circuit breaker sides
Put the suitable warning tags

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Portable air blower, metal brush
Telescope crane and lifting crane
Set of common screw drivers, and cleaning material (arg, cloth)
USSR grease (220) and water pump
Micrometer, electronic breaking analyzer (type TM 1600 / MA 31)

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Examine the external parts 
of (arc extinction, isolator) chambers

Check the presence of 
surface defects or cracks at the (arc extinction, isolator)

Check the tightening of 
the bolts and nuts

Maintain the phase cabinet 
(opening and closing valves) and the main cabinet (filter, non-returned valves) 
and air pressure manometers

Dismantle and maintenance 
main piston and aux. Piston of mechanism of the arc extinction chamber and 
isolator chamber

Measure the DC 
resistance of arc extinction chamber, isolator contacts and busbar

Check the (air leakage, 
unsealing pressure, self closing pressure and pressure drop stability)

Check the quantity of 
ventilated air and adjust it

Measure the resistance 
of parallel resistors

Measure and test 
switch (on & off) of CB
Clean the insulator of CB

Check hot points of all 
parts of CB
